h1: Surintara Resort Surin — the spacious, park-at-your-door resort near Huay Saneng Reservoir
intro: If you're driving into Surin and want a single-storey resort with spacious rooms and a parking bay right at your door, all at a friendly price, Surintara Resort is a name road-trippers mention often · It's a 3-star resort with 34 rooms in Nok Mueang, on the edge of town near Huay Saneng Reservoir · Rooms are roomy and clean, some with a small balcony, set around a leafy garden with an in-house restaurant — from around ฿520/night · Real guest reviews praise the spacious rooms, the cleanliness, the easy parking and the friendly staff, while the main trade-off is the out-of-town location — you'll want your own car.

body.html: Surintara Resort sits at 246 Moo 16, Nok Mueang, in Mueang Surin · It's a 34-room, 3-star single-storey resort that positions itself clearly as an affordable resort-style stay rather than a city hotel block · The buildings run in rows around a garden, with a parking bay in front of each room — and that's exactly what self-driving guests mention most, since you can step out of the car and straight into your room without dragging luggage far.

Rooms focus on space and simplicity · Most reviews agree the rooms are more spacious than expected for the price, clean and comfortable to sleep in · Every room has air-con, a TV, a fridge, free bottled water and free Wi-Fi, and some have a small balcony you can sit out on · The furnishing and décor are simple, in keeping with a budget resort — not luxurious, but functional for a relaxing stay or an overnight stop on a road trip.
"Spacious, very clean room, and you can park right in front of the door — so handy when you're driving yourself. Friendly staff and great value."

On site there's an in-house restaurant and a leafy garden to stroll or sit in · There's laundry service and Wi-Fi in both the rooms and common areas · The front desk handles check-in and check-out and can point you to drives and sights around town · The overall feel is quieter than a city-centre hotel — good for travellers who want a relaxed, low-key base away from the noise of the main road.

Location is both the draw and the trade-off here · The resort is in Nok Mueang, on the edge of town near Huay Saneng Reservoir, a popular local spot for sunset views and a lakeside stroll · It's a short drive into the city centre, the City Pillar Shrine and the markets · The upside is that it's quiet, leafy and easy to park; the trade-off is that it isn't walking distance to the markets or the train station — without your own car you'll rely on a ride. It suits self-drivers more than train arrivals.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: Surintara Resort is a budget resort that scores well on cleanliness and value, but it isn't a luxury stay with a pool · The gripes are about expectations — simple amenities, no lift or pool, and an out-of-town location that needs a car · Guests who understand they're booking a mid-budget single-storey resort tend to be happy with the spacious, clean rooms and park-at-your-door bays, while those expecting city-hotel standards may find it plain.

In short, if you're driving around Surin and want a quiet resort with spacious, clean rooms, parking at your door and Huay Saneng nearby, starting at just a few hundred baht — Surintara Resort is a sensible pick · The cross-platform picture is consistent: "spacious, clean, good value, easy parking, friendly staff" · It suits self-driving families, travellers stopping overnight, and anyone wanting a quiet out-of-town base while using Surin as a hub.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're driving, ask the front desk for a room with an easy parking bay and a balcony to get the full resort feel · In the late afternoon, drive over to nearby Huay Saneng Reservoir for the sunset · And if you're visiting during the Surin Elephant Round-up (mid-November), book several weeks ahead, as accommodation across the whole province fills up fast.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Surintara Resort Surin

faq.q: Where is Surintara Resort in Surin, and is it near Huay Saneng?
faq.a: Surintara Resort is at 246 Moo 16, Nok Mueang, Mueang Surin · It's on the edge of town near Huay Saneng Reservoir, a popular local spot for sunset views · It's a short drive into the city centre, the City Pillar Shrine and the markets · It suits self-drivers more than train arrivals, since it isn't walking distance to the markets.

faq.q: How much does Surintara Resort cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿520/night for a Standard Room · A Standard Twin runs about ฿560, a Superior Room around ฿620 and a Family Room around ฿850 · Prices vary by date and platform, and rise during the Surin Elephant Round-up — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Surintara Resort spacious and clean?
faq.a: Most reviews praise the spacious rooms — larger than expected for the price — and the cleanliness · Every room has air-con, a TV, a fridge, free bottled water and free Wi-Fi, and some have a small balcony · It's a single-storey resort with a parking bay at your door, very handy for self-drivers · The trade-offs are simple décor and no pool.

faq.q: Who is Surintara Resort best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for self-driving travellers, families and anyone wanting a quiet out-of-town stay · The park-at-your-door bays and leafy garden suit groups arriving by car · It's not for train arrivals without a car, or for guests wanting a pool, gym and city-hotel facilities.

faq.q: Does Surintara Resort have parking and a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes — there's free parking right in front of each room and an in-house restaurant, plus a leafy garden and laundry service · The park-at-your-door layout is what self-drivers mention most, since you step from the car straight into your room · For other meals, it's a short drive into town for Isaan food at the markets.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, especially for the Surin Elephant Round-up?
faq.a: In normal periods, 1–2 weeks ahead is fine · But for the Surin Elephant Round-up in mid-November, book several weeks ahead, as accommodation across the whole province fills fast · Every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm yet.
